explanation:
The owned baseline has three concrete defects, submitted separately: missing native cache_turn description, native/ANSI accounting divergence, and cached Devin authentication surviving AssignModel rejection. None is a new 18.10 upstream regression. Correction to the third finding's secondary reference: the exact AssignModel HTTP-error throw is replay-18.7.0/pi-ai/src/providers/devin.ts:845, not :847; its patch anchor at :264-267 is correct. No files were edited and no tests, builds, provider requests, desktop actions, or native execution were performed.

COMPARISON ROOTS: All relative references below are under /tmp/omp-18100-audit-cd9kqmcj/{pristine-18.7.0,replay-18.7.0,pristine-18.10.0}/node_modules/@oh-my-pi, explicitly identified as baseline/patched/target. Native declarations additionally use the parent's dependency-complete runtime-18.7.0 and runtime-18.10.0 roots. The partial replay-18.10.0 was not used as a candidate.

family-status-accounting — REBASE, blocked on the two baseline native-status repairs. Preserve main-assistant-only cache hit accounting in SessionEntryIndex, reset/rebuild behavior, cache-inclusive total usage, and settled-turn cache display. Patched pi-tui/src/status-line/segments.ts:739-759 and :993-1044 show that render and describe disagree and that cache_turn lacks describe entirely. Consumer dispatch at patched segments.ts:1337 and component.ts:3598-3602 makes this an actual native-UI problem, not a declaration-only nit. Target segments.ts:1329-1330 still uses that dispatch contract, so clean application would not repair it. Upstream changes to reset-credit coloring, hostname caching, git status, and Vim REPLACE are orthogonal and should remain intact. Minimal acceptance: call the real describeSegment for cache_turn, cache_hit and token_total with synthetic main and auxiliary usage; require no exception, the primary-only rate, and totals including both cache-read counters, then compare ANSI output numerically. Preserve source/declaration closure for session-manager, StatusLineSession, and the segment identifier tuple. Session-cumulative accounting across index entries is intentional; it is not a branch-only statistic defect.

family-antigravity-wire — RETAIN its behavior, rebase only as required by the complete ordered chain. The entire provider file pi-ai/src/providers/google-gemini-cli.ts is whitespace-insensitive identical between pristine18.7 and pristine18.10; upstream has not adopted deterministic session/agent/trajectory identities, omission of requestType:agent, or side-turn step/lastExecutionId isolation. The patch's envelope change is at original provider :1220 and buildRequest :1389; successful-response commit guard is at :1072. Preserve deterministic main identity across fresh resume and prevent :side: turns from advancing main execution lineage. Target catalog discovery DOES change independently: pi-catalog/src/discovery/antigravity.ts:153 onward now returns {models} or {rejectedStatus}, distinct from transient null. Its real consumer, provider-models/google.ts:100-140, explicitly retains the prior catalog on transient failure and routes rejected-account results before unioning rosters. This new boundary is handled; no silent-drop finding is warranted. Minimal acceptance: two fresh buildRequest calls with the same session identity produce the same stable envelope fields; an intervening side turn changes neither main step nor lastExecutionId; requestType stays absent. Do not assert server cache hits from deterministic envelopes alone.

family-devin-wire — REBASE, preserving all local protections and fixing the submitted AssignModel cache invalidation gap. Upstream 18.10 still lacks the auth cache/epoch protections, standalone trailing thinking-signature capture, sealed replay signatureType, per-process metadata sessionId/requestId, and main-cascade idle keepalive pin. Patched producer-to-consumer chain was traced: agent-session.ts:11042 pins only Devin idle calls; :11162 forwards conversationId; pi-ai/src/stream.ts:1910 preserves it; providers/devin.ts chooses conversationId before sessionId; catalog/wire/devin.ts:68-69 emits session/request identity. Patched signatureType is :1002; target remains empty at providers/devin.ts:795, and target :411 only attaches a signature inside a deltaThinking branch. These are lost local protections if omitted, not new upstream regressions. Rebase must retain upstream's new ConnectFrameDecoder/frameConnectMessage transport, block-index map, thinking summary:false, foreign tool-call ID sanitization/collision-aware transformMessages path at target :239-252, and bare UUID fallback assistant IDs at :783-792. Upstream also deliberately changes default generation parameters at :716-726: maxNewlines 400, temperature 1, topK 40, float32-rounded topP 0.95, and no injected default stop patterns. Do not revert those to 18.7 while transplanting auth retry code. Target wire/devin.ts is unchanged from pristine18.7, so local metadata identity remains required. Minimal acceptance: actual provider execution over synthetic protobuf/Connect frames must retain a signature delivered after thinking_end, then serialize replay with signatureType sealed; one cached-token AssignModel 401 must refresh once before the single chat request. The same fixture can check idle cascade pinning and ordinary side-turn separation. No live service behavior was inferred.

Devin/catalog and image-budget coordination: Target discovery/devin.ts changes normalizeDevinModels to consume the full discovery response, honors defaultOverrideModelConfig, and marks/reroutes the account default; compat/rules/providers/devin.kdl changes only commentary. These are intentional account-default semantics, not grounds to revert saved model selection. The cache-provider-id.ts upstream change is Cursor v4→v5 only, not a Devin or CommandCode namespace rewrite. Historical 0057 belongs to family-image-budget-snapcompact, NOT family-devin-wire: plan.tsv:6 versus :13 proves ownership. Patched snapcompact/src/snapcompact.ts:638-639 has both devin and devin-agent image limits of 200; stock target lacks those entries. Preserve them through that family's owner. The Devin serializer still emits images for user and tool-result prompts (target providers/devin.ts:730-745 and :800-816); no local image-budget retirement is justified by upstream provider formatting changes.

0065-commandcode-deepseek-model-record-parity — RETAIN, with chain-context rebase if necessary. The specific provider KDL is unchanged between pristine18.7 and pristine18.10; upstream has not adopted supports-strict-mode true and supports-multiple-system-messages false for deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash. These are behavioral, not cosmetic, fields: target pi-ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts:2365-2369 determines ordered system-prompt coalescing and :2804-2808 controls strict schema adaptation. Losing them changes tools and request-head bytes when built-in records replace plugin records on resume. Preserve existing text/image modalities and effort routing rather than reconstructing a partial model record. Minimal acceptance: resolve actual plugin and built-in records for the same model, then compare serialized system/tool portions before and after synthetic resume, including strict schema output and multiple ordered system prompts. No unsupported claim of identical cache hits across an upstream version change is made.

family-image-display — REBASE, not retire. Target pi-tui/src/chat/image-loading.ts is unchanged from pristine18.7; it does not subsume content fingerprints, bounded pending/settled/failure slots, retry/error labels, or the tool-image retirement barrier. Migrate the complete API cutover (imageFingerprint/ensurePng/completedPng/pngFailureReason) across assistant-message.ts, tool-execution.ts and dist/types/chat/image-loading.d.ts; target still imports the old three helpers at assistant-message.ts:26 and tool-execution.ts:50. Keep PNG-preferred Jupyter MIME deduplication in pi-coding-agent/src/eval/py/display.ts. Important upstream interaction: assistant-message.ts now uses #kittyDisplayed plus #kittyPreviouslyDisplayed and releases hidden/replaced display images (target :252-273, :1511-1548, :1761 onward), replacing the old permanent #kittyConverted map. Port failure state and completion handling without restoring permanent retention of every converted image. Target transcript-container.ts:154-155 combines isTranscriptBlockFinalized with isTranscriptBlockPending; tool-execution.ts:796-799 still has no pending PNG barrier. Keep the local image-conversion barrier and version invalidation alongside upstream figure-pending behavior. Minimal acceptance: a delayed non-PNG tool image must prevent retirement until either a PNG or sanitized failure label is committed; one repeated corrupt payload must share the retained failure result; successful conversion must not mutate provider message content. Exercise the real transcript/tool consumer, not only ensurePng. Oversized/evicted entries being eligible for another conversion is consistent with the bounded-cache contract and was not reported as unconditional single-flight failure.

optional0097 — BLOCK for 18.10; remain explicitly undeployed and excluded from deployed24. patches/native-computeruse.json:2-13 pins 18.7.0 commit e0fc1cf, linux-x64-modern binary SHA-256 95a8143429c1205fe24c1ac7947eff1ca919ea0bd4886b451615284bbd6b35c5, stock binary hash, source patch hash and Cargo.lock hash. native-computeruse.ts:39-46 rejects a different release/host, and :58-60 rejects an unknown stock binary; these are correct safety barriers, not defects to bypass. The optional TypeScript cancel(reason) API is paired with a real native mapping in .native-sources/18.7.0/0097-computeruse.patch:1349-1351 through CancelReason::from_label; it is not just a declaration annotation. Target stock DesktopSession.cancel remains argumentless, while the target native ABI adds screenState, IpcConnection/IpcServer, grammar-directory configuration, HDiffPatch support and more. In particular runtime18.10 pi-natives/native/index.js:34-35 exports new IPC classes, and target coding-agent/src/launch/client.ts:265 and lsp/mux/daemon.ts:198 consume IpcConnection.connect; replacing the target addon with the 18.7 optional binary would remove required non-desktop APIs. Target worker.ts:978-996 also reads screenState, though protocol.ts:48-49 tolerates its absence, so that particular read is not a proven crash. Migration requires a new release-pinned native source rebase/build, preserving upstream native exports and loader behavior, regenerated matching declarations, fresh stock/artifact/source/lock hashes, a version-specific controller contract, and explicit optional selection only. Minimal acceptance after authorization: static/native-export closure and a synthetic worker cancellation-reason fixture with no desktop actions; separately verify the deployed selector still resolves exactly the 24 base families. Do not broaden this research into activating or executing computer use.

Recommended parent probes are limited to the native-status actual-consumer fixture, synthetic Devin auth/signature/serialization fixture, and delayed-image retirement fixture above. All three mandatory policy grep checks were performed and matched: patch-rollup-contracts (Pristine input/Full-chain verification/Same-family repairs), verification-gate-contracts (gate falsifiability/root redirection/synthetic fixtures), and PRD R7/R9/R10. No owned family has demonstrated full upstream equivalence sufficient for retirement.
